NEED TO KNOW

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Who can join the online coaching program?

Anyone ready to work toward a fitness goal and willing to follow a structured plan. Your starting point and needs are reviewed first.

Do I need to train in a gym?

Tell us what equipment you have in the intake form so the plan can be designed around your available setup.

Is nutrition guidance included?

Yes. Nutrition guidance is part of the listed coaching packages and is planned around your goal and preferences.

Is there follow-up?

Yes. Weekly progress follow-up is included, with plan adjustments when needed.

How do I get started?

Complete the coaching assessment form using any of the Get Started or Subscribe buttons. You can then discuss the next steps.
